objects.name: Analytic 2192
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) network device syslog showing a gap in expected event sequence numbers, or syslog forwarding interruption from a device coinciding with a period of suspicious activity on that device. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: networkdevice:syslog
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: syslog sequence number gap or forwarding interruption coinciding with suspicious activity window for the same device

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of processes/accounts authorized to delete or truncate ICS application logs.
Time window prior to a log-clear event within which other suspicious activity is considered correlated.
Documented schedule for legitimate, automated log rotation/archival.
